body.text: Upper vs Lower Body Division Game — Open Hand Connections
This is fighting for upper body or legs.

items: The upper body player wins with an underhook on the lower body player, or by putting his hands on the mat.
The lower body player wins with a touch behind the upper body player's leg, or by putting his hands on the mat.

body.text: This is knocking a standing man down, sitting.

items: The bottom player wins by standing up to grab the top player's hips, or by putting the top player's back on the mat and standing.
The top player wins by touching his shin to the bottom player's knees or body.

body.text: Back Take – Maintain Chest to Back Contact
This is holding his back from behind.

items: The attacker holds as long as he keeps contact.
The defender wins by getting his back to the mat or turning face to face.

slides.title: What made it work?
slides.question: You're moving your partner using only touches to his wrist, elbow, or head. What's the smart move?

options.text: Keep every touch on the wrist, elbow, or head.
options.feedback: Gripping on purpose, not grabbing anywhere, is the same as giving something that actually helps.

options.text: Touch anywhere on his body to move him.
options.feedback: Touching anywhere breaks the rule and stalls your progress.

options.text: Grab his leg to move him faster.
options.feedback: Stay on wrist, elbow, or head instead.
